title: Carbon fibre weave and forged carbon
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of carbon fibre composite: 2x2 twill or plain weave tows with fibre lines and direction-dependent sheen, forged carbon from chopped-fibre patches, or an aramid hybrid weave, under gloss or matte finish. Use for car parts, helmets, bicycles, cases and props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python carbon_fibre.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: style
parameters.meaning: Construction: 0 2x2 twill, 1 plain weave, 2 forged (chopped fibre).

parameters.name: tows_across
parameters.meaning: Tows across the tile (rounded up to a multiple of the weave repeat); forged patches scale with it.

parameters.name: clear_coat
parameters.meaning: Gloss of the clear coat (0 dry matte weave, 1 deep gloss).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Black 2x2 twill carbon under gloss clear coat.

presets.name: forged
presets.description: Forged carbon with marbled chopped-fibre patches.

presets.name: kevlar_hybrid
presets.description: Yellow aramid and black carbon tows in twill.

presets.name: matte_dry
presets.description: Uncoated dry twill with a matte finish.

limits: The sheen of each tow direction is baked into albedo and roughness; real weave shifts with the view and light angle, which needs an anisotropic shader. Forged carbon patches are Voronoi cells, a simplification of pressed chopped fibre. A clear coat is approximated by low roughness; add a clear coat layer in your engine for its second reflection. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Weave drafts for 2x2 twill and plain weave on a tow grid
Tow cross-section and fibre lines in tow-relative coordinates
Worley patches with a per-patch fibre direction for forged carbon
